verdict.rationale: Mercury clearly supports card issuance with role-based limits and permissions (mercury-docs-1, mercury-docs-10, mercury-docs-27, mercury-comm-1), and business credit cards are available 'day one', but nearly all documentation and community evidence emphasizes virtual cards for spend control rather than confirming physical card issuance workflows tied to employee roles. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of physical card issuance/mailing process, and confirmation that role/permission assignment applies specifically to physical (not just virtual) cards.
